scope: Fixed eight-member development selection. One common raw-baseline data-selected point per recording, initial catalogue and original/joined pool. Conditional initializer/coarse diagnostic only, not a full search, final B7 result or geographic validation.
retrospective_selection_scope: Compare two already computed states using the same original-support coherence cost only. Both c arms share selection before inspecting coarse scores. This is an offline incumbent audit with common preprocessing work, not an executed production initializer or independent validation.
